note: level: reference = hand-entered formula (identity only); derived = computed here from a formula; resolved = fetched live. ghs_codes null means NOT RESOLVED, which is not the same as no hazard.

compounds.name: D-glucose
compounds.notes: Cellulose hydrolysis endpoint. An ordinary metabolite, which is why the cellulose route has the mildest product profile of any material here.

compounds.name: terephthalic acid
compounds.notes: PET hydrolysis product. Hazard status must be resolved live before any claim about product safety.

compounds.name: ethylene glycol
compounds.notes: PET hydrolysis co-product. THE product to bound rather than wave past on the polyester route - small enough to escape the gel mesh easily, which is what the capture gate is for.

compounds.name: mono(2-hydroxyethyl) terephthalate
compounds.notes: PETase product; MHETase substrate. Accumulates when the downstream partner is absent.

compounds.name: bis(2-hydroxyethyl) terephthalate
compounds.notes: Soluble PET oligomer, widely used as an assay substrate - which is why constants measured on it are oligomer-level rather than polymer-level evidence.

compounds.name: 3-hydroxybutyric acid
compounds.notes: PHA hydrolysis product; a ketone body, cleared metabolically.

compounds.name: succinic acid
compounds.notes: PBS hydrolysis product; a citric-acid-cycle intermediate.

compounds.name: 1,4-butanediol
compounds.notes: PBS co-product. Not metabolic in f2c's sense; needs capture.

compounds.name: bisphenol A
compounds.notes: Polycarbonate hydrolysis product. The clearest case for resolving hazard data live: it lands in requires_active_capture by set difference today, with no toxicological basis recorded anywhere in the project.

compounds.name: carbonate
compounds.notes: Polycarbonate hydrolysis co-product. Enters the bicarbonate buffer system, so it is treated as metabolically cleared - unlike bisphenol A, the other product of the same reaction, which is not.

compounds.name: 2,5-furandicarboxylic acid
compounds.notes: PEF hydrolysis product, the furanoate analogue of terephthalic acid.

compounds.name: generic oligomer
compounds.notes: Placeholder for an unspecified oligomeric product. The weight is a stated assumption, not a measurement, and a run that depends on it should say so.

compounds.name: iron(II/III) ion
compounds.notes: Iron-route product. An ion, not a metabolite: capture rather than rate is the binding constraint on that route. Radius is an ionic radius, not derived from molecular weight.

compounds.name: generic metal ion
compounds.notes: Stand-in for an unspecified liberated metal ion. Radius is an ionic radius, not derived from molecular weight.

compounds.name: detached microparticle
compounds.notes: Not a molecule. The 50 nm radius is a nominal lower bound for detached particulate, used so the mesh term treats it as immobile. Its presence at all is a gate failure.
